captions.detailed: A wall-mounted transfer arm featuring a dark gray rectangular backplate, an orange-brown tapered first link, an offset elbow joint, and a second orange-brown link leading to a square dark gray end plate. The mechanism functions as a load-bearing reach device with two main arm segments connected by parallel horizontal pivot joints. The first link pivots from a bracket on the backplate, while the second link pivots at the elbow knuckle and terminates at a rotating wrist axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a wall-mounted transfer arm with a rectangular backplate, a tapered upper arm, an offset elbow knuckle, a lower arm, and a square end plate. The arm segments should be colored in an orange-brown material, while the backplate, mounting brackets, and end plate should be a dark gray material.
captions.factory: Construct a base backplate using a box primitive and attach a projecting shoulder bracket. Create the first arm link by lofting or extruding a tapered profile, and connect it to the shoulder bracket. Build an offset elbow knuckle block, attach the second tapered arm link, and terminate the assembly with a square end plate possessing mounting holes.
